'''Ferrig''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to boost the troops' morale by recovering supplies from the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]].
